title: types(jsx): improve type for number attributes
body:
fix #3788

Improve some of the types, most of the types had `number`  which is not valid HTML, all the `number` attributes should be valid string
```html
<textarea cols="3"/>
```


Also: 
- replaced all `boolean | 'false' | 'true'` to be `Booleanish`
- added to `capture` keywords: "The attribute's keywords are `user` and `environment`" [The capture attribute](https://www.w3.org/TR/html-media-capture/#the-capture-attribute)
